concerns.text: Missing task for Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene). The constitution mandates that 'Datasets MUST be checksummed and the checksum recorded under data/'. No task in Phase 1 (T002) or elsewhere implements this checksumming process.

Missing coverage for Plan element 'PCA Dimensionality Reduction'. The plan's Complexity Tracking explicitly requires PCA to preserve network-specific signal, but T003 only implements a single scalar 'Variability_Metric' (mean edge SD).

Missing coverage for Plan element 'AR Surrogate Null Model'. The plan's Complexity Tracking rejects phase-shuffling as 'trivial' and mandates an AR-based surrogate. T006 implements 'phase-shuffled surrogate time-series', failing to cover the plan's technical requirement.
